arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test that +0100 and +01:00 now produce equivalent FixedTzOffset
tz_from_0100 = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b').fixed[0].tzinfo
tz_from_01_colon = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b').fixed[0].tzinfo

print('From +0100:', tz_from_0100)
print('From +01:00:', tz_from_01_colon)
print('Equal?', tz_from_0100 == tz_from_01_colon)

# Also test with t530
t530 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-5 * 60 - 30, '-5:30')
tz_from_530 = parse.parse('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b').fixed[0].tzinfo
tz_from_5_colon_30 = parse.parse('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -5:30 b').fixed[0].tzinfo

print()
print('From -530:', tz_from_530)
print('From -5:30:', tz_from_5_colon_30)
print('Equal to t530?', tz_from_530 == t530)
"
